{{Quote|A corridor collapsed near life support and a length of pipe impaled him to a wall.|Transmission from ''Band Light'', concerning Red|<ref name="FUII">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
'''Red''' was a member of the crew of the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Band Light]]'', which was suspected of [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] during the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Terror" /> At some point before or during [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> he and the rest of the crew of the ''Band Light'' were investigating an [[Etti Lighter|''Etti''-class light transport]] adrift near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] when he [[Death/Legends|died]]. While he was going through the light [[Transport/Legends|transport]], he was impaled and eviscerated by an Imperial [[Terror Trooper]]. It was later speculated by the other crew members and the [[Unidentified captain of the Band Light|captain]] that his death was an accident and that a corridor near the [[Life support/Legends|life support]] had collapsed and a length of pipe had impaled him to a wall and eviscerated him.<ref name="Terror" />

==Behind the scenes==
Red was mentioned in the "[[Terror Trooper]]" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', which was released on [[October 26]], [[2010]].<ref name="FUII" />
